title: Size Distribution of All Italian Cities
title_zh: 意大利城市规模分布
title_primary: 意大利城市规模分布
title_secondary: Size Distribution of All Italian Cities
authors: Marianna Belloc
official: 官方在线 2026-01-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: By revisiting well-established empirical regularities, this paper examines the distributional properties of city sizes in Italy over the period 2001-2024. Three main findings emerge. First, when considering the full population of approximately 7,900 municipalities, city sizes are well approximated by a lognormal distribution. Second, consistent with Gibrat’s law, city population growth rates appear to be independent of initial city size. Third, the upper tail of the distribution follows Zipf’s law, although the results are sensitive to the choice of truncation threshold. The implications of these findings are discussed in relation to urban dynamics and the organization of the Italian urban system.
abstract_zh: 通过重新审视既有的实证规律，本文考察了2001年至2024年间意大利城市规模的分布特征。主要发现有三点。首先，在考虑约7900个市镇的全部人口时，城市规模近似服从对数正态分布。其次，与吉布拉特定律一致，城市人口增长率似乎与初始城市规模无关。第三，分布的上尾遵循齐普夫定律，尽管结果对截断阈值的选择较为敏感。本文讨论了这些发现对城市动态及意大利城市体系组织的意义。

title: Does local empowerment come at an ecological cost? Evidence from China’s county power expansion reform
title_zh: 地方赋权是否以生态成本为代价？来自中国县域扩权改革的证据
title_primary: 地方赋权是否以生态成本为代价？来自中国县域扩权改革的证据
title_secondary: Does local empowerment come at an ecological cost? Evidence from China’s county power expansion reform
authors: Chu-Yu Guo, Zhida Jin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines how enhanced local autonomy affects ecological quality by analysing China’s County Power Expansion reform, which granted unprecedented fiscal and administrative powers to county governments. Using a comprehensive ecological index that captures multiple environmental dimensions, we find that the reform is associated with a decline of 0.64 index points in local ecological quality. This deterioration is associated with a stronger prioritization of economic development, reflected in increased growth-oriented expenditure and business attraction, while environmental protection expenditure did not increase significantly. The negative ecological effects are amplified in counties facing stronger economic pressures but mitigated where environmental performance metrics are included in official evaluations. These findings reveal important trade-offs in decentralized environmental governance and highlight how institutional incentives can shape local governments’ environmental decisions. KEYWORDS: Environmental governance decentralization ecological quality local government behaviour county-power-expansion reform China JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q56 Q58 P25 H70 R50 Acknowledgements We thank the editor and two anonymous referees for their insightful feedback.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过分析中国“扩权强县”改革（该改革赋予县级政府前所未有的财政与行政权力），探讨地方自主权增强对生态质量的影响。基于涵盖多维度环境指标的综合生态指数，我们发现该改革导致地方生态质量下降0.64个指数点。这种退化与地方政府更侧重经济发展优先相关，具体表现为增长导向型支出和招商引资力度增强，而环境保护支出未显著增加。在面临较强经济压力的县域，生态负面效应被放大；但在官员考核纳入环境绩效指标的县域，该效应得到缓解。这些发现揭示了环境治理分权化中的重要权衡，并凸显制度激励如何塑造地方政府的环境决策。关键词：环境治理 分权化 生态质量 地方政府行为 扩权强县改革 中国 JEL分类：Q56 Q58 P25 H70 R50 致谢：感谢编辑及两位匿名审稿人的真知灼见。

title: Platform Tying and its Effects
title_zh: 平台捆绑及其影响
title_primary: 平台捆绑及其影响
title_secondary: Platform Tying and its Effects
authors: Massimo Motta, Leonardo Madio, Fabio Manenti
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study on-platform tying by a dominant platform that controls a primary access point and operates an adjacent specialised service. A rival service can reach users both through the dominant platform and through a direct channel. In a two-sided market where platforms charge sellers and seller participation affects consumer demand, tying improves the integrated service, but also shifts demand away from the rival. We show that lower mediated demand reduces seller participation on the rival platform, weakening the rival also for users who access it directly. As a result, tying can reduce consumer surplus and welfare once the direct channel is sufficiently large. We also compare tying with demotion and with a common-access policy, and show that our main insights carry over to a one-sided model in which network effects operate among consumers who pay directly for the specialised service.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一家主导平台在控制主要接入点并运营相邻专业化服务时的平台内捆绑行为。竞争性服务既可通过主导平台触达用户，也可通过直接渠道触达用户。在平台向卖家收费且卖家参与影响消费者需求的双边市场中，捆绑行为虽能提升整合服务的质量，但也会导致需求从竞争平台转移。研究表明，中介需求的降低会减少竞争平台上的卖家参与，从而削弱该平台对直接访问用户的吸引力。因此，当直接渠道规模足够大时，捆绑行为可能降低消费者剩余和社会福利。我们还将捆绑行为与降级处理及公共接入政策进行了比较，并证明主要结论可延伸至网络效应作用于直接为专业化服务付费的消费者之间的单边模型。

title: The Economics of Tariffs
title_zh: 关税经济学
title_primary: 关税经济学
title_secondary: The Economics of Tariffs
authors: Ossa, Ralph, Redding, Stephen, Redding, Stephen James
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: A central insight from neoclassical economics is that international trade operates like an improvement in production technology. It generates mutual aggregate welfare gains for countries as a whole, but creates winners and losers within countries. Tariffs are a tax on this trading technology and distort the prices faced by domestic consumers and producers. Large countries can use tariffs to improve their terms of trade on world markets. But if all countries try to do so, they can end up with lower welfare than if they cooperated to liberalize trade. Tariffs can be used to redistribute income between the winners and losers from trade within countries. But there can be other more efficient ways to achieve redistribution. Policies to promote economic activity in critical industries can be rationalized based on externalities or national security. But these arguments typically rationalize targeted policies towards those industries and tariffs can be dominated by other policy interventions. Empirical findings from the recent waves of U.S. tariffs suggest that most of the incidence of these tariffs has been borne by U.S. importers, wholesalers, retailers and consumers rather than by foreign exporters. These tariffs have led to a large-scale reorganization of U.S. supply chains away from China to third countries. Although this reorganization has substantially reduced China's share of U.S. imports, the U.S. remains indirectly exposed to China through the imports of these third countries.
abstract_zh: 新古典经济学的一个核心洞见是，国际贸易如同生产技术的改进。它为各国整体带来相互的总体福利增益，但在国家内部则产生赢家和输家。关税是对这种贸易技术的一种税收，扭曲了国内消费者和生产者所面对的价格。大国可以利用关税来改善其在世界市场上的贸易条件。但如果所有国家都试图这样做，最终可能比合作实现贸易自由化时的福利更低。关税可用于在国内贸易的赢家和输家之间重新分配收入，但可能存在其他更有效的再分配方式。基于外部性或国家安全的理由，可以合理化对关键产业的经济活动促进政策，但这些论点通常合理化针对这些产业的定向政策，而关税可能被其他政策干预所超越。近期美国关税浪潮的实证发现表明，这些关税的大部分负担由美国进口商、批发商、零售商和消费者承担，而非外国出口商。这些关税导致美国供应链大规模重组，从中国转向第三国。尽管这一重组大幅降低了中国在美国进口中的份额，但美国仍通过从这些第三国的进口间接暴露于中国。

title: Contextually Private Mechanisms
title_zh: 情境化隐私机制
title_primary: 情境化隐私机制
title_secondary: Contextually Private Mechanisms
authors: Haupt, Andreas, Hitzig, Zoë
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: A designer employs a dynamic protocol to elicit private information. Protocols produce a set of contextual privacy violations— information learned that may be superfluous given the context. A protocol is maximally contextually private if there is no protocol that produces a proper subset of the violations it produces, while implementing the choice rule. Contextual privacy violations arise when a choice rule makes some agents collectively, but not individually, pivotal. In auctions, designing for contextual privacy requires choosing an initial question posed to each agent and the order for querying agents. Ascending-join protocols are maximally contextually private for k-item Vickrey auctions.
abstract_zh: 设计者采用动态协议来获取私人信息。协议会产生一系列情境性隐私侵犯——即在特定情境下可能属于多余的信息被获知。若不存在其他协议能在实现选择规则的同时，产生该协议所引发侵犯行为的真子集，则该协议具有最大情境隐私性。当选择规则使某些代理人集体成为关键角色（而非个体关键角色）时，便会产生情境性隐私侵犯。在拍卖中，实现情境隐私性设计需要确定向每位代理人提出的初始问题及询问代理人的顺序。对于k物品维克里拍卖而言，升序接入协议具有最大情境隐私性。

title: Deadwood Labor? The Effects of Eliminating Employment Protection for Older Workers
title_zh: 枯木劳动力？取消老年工人就业保护的影响
title_primary: 枯木劳动力？取消老年工人就业保护的影响
title_secondary: Deadwood Labor? The Effects of Eliminating Employment Protection for Older Workers
authors: Saez, Emmanuel, Schoefer, Benjamin, Seim, David
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We analyze mandatory retirement in Sweden which eliminates entirely employment protection at age 67. Employment falls by about 10 percent and total average earnings by about 20 percent immediately at age 67. 8 percent of jobs separate immediately due to loss of protection, with effects stemming from jobs with stronger initial employment protection (long tenure, firms subject to “last in, first out” rules), and those in the public sector. We examine effects on continuing jobs. While wages appear rigid, we uncover novel, sizable intensive-margin hours reductions, resulting in an 8 percent drop in earnings conditional on staying on the job.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了瑞典的强制退休制度，该制度在67岁时完全取消就业保护。67岁后，就业率立即下降约10%，平均总收入下降约20%。由于保护措施失效，8%的工作岗位立即终止，这一影响主要源于初始就业保护较强的岗位（如长期任职、受“后进先出”规则约束的企业）以及公共部门岗位。我们进一步考察了持续就业岗位的影响。尽管工资水平看似刚性，但我们发现了新颖且显著的集约边际工时缩减现象，导致在职人员收入下降8%。

title: Prime Locations
title_zh: 黄金地段
title_primary: 黄金地段
title_secondary: Prime Locations
authors: Ahlfeldt, Gabriel M., Albers, Thilo N. H., Behrens, Kristian
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a method for delineating prime locations—ultra-dense clusters of economic activity—within cities and apply it to comprehensive establishment data covering all US metropolitan areas. We further use big data to extend the analysis to a global context where administrative data are sparse. Many cities in the US and around the world are dominated by a small number of prime locations that can concentrate up to one-half of tradable services jobs on tiny shares of land and are dominant centers of economic gravity. In cities with fewer prime locations, a larger tradable services share concentrates in them.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在城市内部划定核心区位（即经济活动超密集集群）的方法，并将其应用于覆盖美国全部大都市区的综合性企业数据。进一步利用大数据将分析扩展至行政数据稀缺的全球范围。美国及全球众多城市的核心区位数量有限，这些区域能以极小比例的土地集中高达一半的可贸易服务业岗位，并成为主导性的经济引力中心。在核心区位较少的城市中，可贸易服务业岗位的集中度更高。

title: How Social Learning Overcomes Confirmation Bias
title_zh: 社会学习如何克服确认偏误
title_primary: 社会学习如何克服确认偏误
title_secondary: How Social Learning Overcomes Confirmation Bias
authors: Aislinn Bohren, Daniel Hauser
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a flexible model of confirmation bias, in which individuals misinterpret signals as stronger evidence for the state favored by their prior than they actually are. The bias varies with the agent's current belief, nesting Rabin and Schrag (1999) as a special case. In an individual learning setting, incorrect learning arises with positive probability when the bias is severe, generalizing existing work. By contrast, in a social learning setting, correct learning obtains almost surely regardless of the severity of bias. Whereas social information typically introduces inefficiencies, here it mitigates them: social interaction overcomes bias that would otherwise generate incorrect learning.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个灵活的确认偏误模型，在该模型中，个体将信号错误地解读为比实际更强的证据，以支持其先验信念所偏好的状态。该偏误随行为主体当前信念的变化而变化，并将Rabin和Schrag（1999）的研究作为特例。在个体学习情境下，当偏误严重时，错误学习会以正概率发生，这扩展了现有研究。相比之下，在社会学习情境下，无论偏误严重程度如何，正确学习几乎必然实现。尽管社会信息通常会引发效率损失，但在此情境下它反而缓解了效率损失：社会互动克服了原本会导致错误学习的偏误。

title: Uptown Worlds: Directional Bias and House Prices in U.S. Cities
title_zh: 上城世界：美国城市中的方向性偏差与房价
title_primary: 上城世界：美国城市中的方向性偏差与房价
title_secondary: Uptown Worlds: Directional Bias and House Prices in U.S. Cities
authors: Ferdinand Rauch, Simon Schömann
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Experiments from psychology show that people associate northern locations on arbitrary maps with positive value, raising the possibility that this cognitive bias shapes real housing markets. Using parcel-level data on 1.1 million residential properties across 285 cities in the northeastern United States, we find that houses in the northern parts of cities indeed sell at higher market prices. This premium disappears once lot size is controlled for, the only housing characteristic with this property. We argue that a small psychological preference for northness, too small to register as a direct price premium yet large enough to act as a Schelling focal point, could lead to neighborhood sorting and generate these differences in housing quality between the northern and southern parts of cities.
abstract_zh: 心理学实验表明，人们会将任意地图上的北方位置与正向价值相关联，这引发了一种可能性：这种认知偏差可能影响真实的住房市场。基于美国东北部285个城市110万套住宅的地块级数据，我们发现城市北部地区的房屋确实以更高的市场价格成交。一旦控制地块面积这一唯一具有此特性的住房属性，该溢价便消失。我们认为，一种微小的对北方的心理偏好——小到不足以直接体现为价格溢价，却足以作为谢林焦点——可能引发社区分层，并导致城市南北部之间住房质量的差异。

title:
Immigrant Networks, Productive Capacity and Trade in
                    ICT
                    Goods
title_zh: 移民网络、生产能力与ICT产品贸易
title_primary: 移民网络、生产能力与ICT产品贸易
title_secondary:
Immigrant Networks, Productive Capacity and Trade in
                    ICT
                    Goods
authors: Bedassa Tadesse, Roger White
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Information and communication technology (ICT) goods are central to digital transformation, technological upgrading and participation in global production networks. Yet relatively little is known about whether immigrant networks shape international trade in these knowledge‐intensive goods. Using bilateral panel data for 172 countries over the 2000–2021 period, we estimate gravity‐based specifications, Tobit models and linear fixed‐effects models for ICT goods trade. The results show a positive and statistically significant relationship between immigrant networks and ICT goods trade, especially exports. The export relationship remains positive after controlling for productive capacity, while the import relationship weakens. Interaction models further show that immigrant networks are more strongly related to ICT goods trade when immigrants' home countries have greater ICT export capacity. Marginal‐effect estimates indicate that the relationship operates through both the extensive and intensive margins of trade. The findings suggest that immigrant networks are especially relevant for ICT goods trade when cross‐border social and commercial ties connect destination markets to technologically capable home countries.
abstract_zh: 信息与通信技术（ICT）产品是数字化转型、技术升级及参与全球生产网络的核心要素。然而，关于移民网络是否影响这类知识密集型产品的国际贸易，学界认知仍相对有限。本研究基于2000—2021年间172个国家的双边面板数据，采用引力模型设定、Tobit模型及线性固定效应模型对ICT产品贸易进行估计。结果显示，移民网络与ICT产品贸易（尤其是出口）之间存在显著正向统计关系。在控制生产能力后，出口关系仍保持正向，而进口关系则有所减弱。交互模型进一步表明，当移民母国具备更强的ICT出口能力时，移民网络与ICT产品贸易的关联性更为显著。边际效应估计显示，该关系通过贸易的扩展边际与集约边际共同发挥作用。研究结论表明，当跨境社会与商业联系将目的地市场与技术能力较强的母国相连接时，移民网络对ICT产品贸易具有特殊重要性。

title: Demand shocks during the post-pandemic inflation surge: An international perspective
title_zh: 后疫情通胀飙升期间的需求冲击：国际视角
title_primary: 后疫情通胀飙升期间的需求冲击：国际视角
title_secondary: Demand shocks during the post-pandemic inflation surge: An international perspective
authors: Drago Bergholt, Inga Nielsen Friis, Francesco Furlanetto, Kristine Matsen, Ørjan Robstad
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the international dimension of the post-pandemic inflation surge. We estimate an extended structural vector autoregressive (SVAR) model for Norway, Sweden, the United Kingdom, and the United States to disentangle domestic and foreign drivers of inflation. Foreign supply and demand shocks are identified through novel restrictions on import prices and trading-partner output, consistent with a simple New Keynesian model featuring firm-to-firm trade in intermediate inputs. Our results show that international demand shocks played a major role across countries. Foreign supply shocks absorb some explanatory power from domestic supply shocks, but demand factors remain the prevalent source of inflation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了疫情后通胀飙升的国际维度。我们为挪威、瑞典、英国和美国估计了一个扩展的结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型，以区分国内和国外通胀驱动因素。通过针对进口价格和贸易伙伴产出的新颖约束条件，我们识别了外国供给和需求冲击，这与一个包含企业间中间投入贸易的简单新凯恩斯模型相一致。结果表明，国际需求冲击在各国中发挥了重要作用。外国供给冲击从国内供给冲击中吸收了一些解释力，但需求因素仍是通胀的主要来源。

title: Mapping, quantifying and predicting future urban green infrastructure dynamics: The case study of Dire Dawa, Ethiopia
title_zh: 绘制、量化与预测未来城市绿色基础设施动态：以埃塞俄比亚德雷达瓦为例
title_primary: 绘制、量化与预测未来城市绿色基础设施动态：以埃塞俄比亚德雷达瓦为例
title_secondary: Mapping, quantifying and predicting future urban green infrastructure dynamics: The case study of Dire Dawa, Ethiopia
authors: Habtamu Dersso Meseganaw, Kassahun Gashu, Abenezer Wakuma Kitila, Kassaye Hussien
official: 官方在线 October 20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban green infrastructure is a nature-based remedy for urban environmental, social and economic problems. This study mapped and quantified urban green infrastructure (UGI) dynamics in Dire Dawa city and projected future changes for 2055. Landsat and Sentinel-2 data, obtained from the USGS and ESA, respectively, were accessed via the Google Earth Engine platform. A random forest model was employed to classify the images, achieving kappa coefficients of 97%, 88%, 89%, and 90% for the years 1995, 2005, 2016, and 2025, respectively. To quantify and predict UGI dynamics, this study utilized the CA-Markov model and the multi-layer perceptron-artificial neural network (MLP-ANN) method. The results revealed a significant decline in UGI area: reductions of 454.96 ha (1995–2005), 884.22 ha (2005–2016), 269.40 ha (2016–2025), and a total loss of 1608.58 ha (1995–2025). Over the 30-year period (1995–2025), Dire Dawa’s UGI decreased by 23%, while built-up areas increased by 31.9%, and bare land decreased by 8.4%. Spatially, UGI fragmentation was most pronounced in the northern, southern, and central parts of the city. The findings suggest that existing urban planning, management, and land-use policies in Dire Dawa have failed to mitigate UGI loss. Therefore, analyzing UGI dynamics is crucial for informing future urban planning, management strategies, and policymaking to address fragmentation and promote sustainable urban development.

title: Allocative efficiency and the productivity slowdown
title_zh: 配置效率与生产率放缓
title_primary: 配置效率与生产率放缓
title_secondary: Allocative efficiency and the productivity slowdown
authors: Lin Shao, Rongsheng Tang
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper evaluates the contribution of cross‐sector allocative efficiency to the productivity slowdown in the US during the 1970s and 2000s. We extend the framework of Oberfield (2013) to derive sufficient statistics for allocative efficiency and decompose aggregate productivity growth in a multisector economy. We find approximately two‐thirds of the productivity slowdown can be explained by the lack of improvement in allocative efficiency. Furthermore, data shows that increased sector‐level volatility is associated with the deterioration of allocative efficiency.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了20世纪70年代和2000年代美国跨部门配置效率对生产率放缓的贡献。我们扩展了Oberfield（2013）的框架，推导出配置效率的充分统计量，并在多部门经济中分解总体生产率增长。研究发现，约三分之二的生产率放缓可由配置效率缺乏改善来解释。此外，数据显示，部门层面波动性的增加与配置效率的恶化相关联。

title: Virtual currencies in online gaming increase the willingness to pay for loot boxes: an experimental analysis
title_zh: 网络游戏中的虚拟货币提升对开箱付费意愿：一项实验分析
title_primary: 网络游戏中的虚拟货币提升对开箱付费意愿：一项实验分析
title_secondary: Virtual currencies in online gaming increase the willingness to pay for loot boxes: an experimental analysis
authors: Niccolò Toccafondi, Roberto Di Paolo, Sibilla Di Guida
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates how in-game virtual currencies influence consumer spending behaviour. In an incentivized randomized controlled trial with 753 UK participants, we estimate the willingness-to-pay (WTP) for loot boxes represented as risky and ambiguous lotteries. We test the effects of virtual currencies, money illusion, and cognitive-demanding (non-intuitive) exchange rates, three practices commonly used to sell loot boxes. Our results show that WTP is significantly higher when transactions are conducted in virtual currencies with a 1:1 exchange rate compared to British pounds, contributing to the debate on the neutrality of virtual currencies and experimental currency units. Moreover, participants in our study are affected by money illusion distortions, regardless of the exchange rate’s intuitiveness. However, we find no evidence that non-intuitive exchange rates affect participants’ WTP compared to intuitive exchange rates of comparable size. These findings highlight the behavioural distortions induced by common monetization practices in games and provide empirical support for the European Commission’s call for stricter regulation of virtual currencies in digital environments.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了游戏内虚拟货币如何影响消费者支出行为。通过一项包含753名英国参与者的激励性随机对照试验，我们估算了以风险性和模糊性彩票形式呈现的“战利品箱”的支付意愿（WTP）。我们检验了虚拟货币、货币幻觉以及认知负荷（非直观）汇率这三种常用于销售战利品箱的实践效应。结果显示，当交易以1:1汇率的虚拟货币进行时，支付意愿显著高于以英镑计价的情况，这为虚拟货币与实验货币单位的中立性争论提供了新证据。此外，无论汇率是否直观，参与者均受到货币幻觉扭曲的影响。然而，与规模相近的直观汇率相比，我们未发现非直观汇率对参与者支付意愿产生影响的证据。这些发现揭示了游戏中常见货币化实践所引发的行为扭曲，并为欧盟委员会呼吁在数字环境中加强虚拟货币监管提供了实证支持。

title: Online tutoring, school performance, and school-to-work transitions: Evidence from a randomized controlled trial
title_zh: 在线辅导、学业表现与从学校到工作的过渡：来自随机对照试验的证据
title_primary: 在线辅导、学业表现与从学校到工作的过渡：来自随机对照试验的证据
title_secondary: Online tutoring, school performance, and school-to-work transitions: Evidence from a randomized controlled trial
authors: Silke Anger, Bernhard Christoph, Agata Galkiewicz, Shushanik Margaryan, Malte Sandner 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Tutoring programs for low-performing students, delivered in-person or online, effectively enhance school performance, yet their medium- and longer-term impacts on labor market outcomes remain less understood. To address this gap, we conduct a randomized controlled trial with 839 secondary school students in Germany to examine the effects of an online tutoring program for low-performing students on academic performance and school-to-work transitions. The online tutoring program had a non-significant intention-to-treat effect of 0.06 standard deviations on math grades six months after program start. However, among students who had not received other tutoring services prior to the intervention, the program significantly improved math grades by 0.14 standard deviations. Moreover, students in non-academic school tracks experienced smoother school-to-work transitions, with vocational training take-up 18 months later being 5 percentage points higher—an effect that was even larger (12 percentage points) among those without prior tutoring. Overall, the results indicate that tutoring can generate lasting benefits for low-performing students that extend beyond school performance.

title: Staffing agencies and in-house bargaining
title_zh: 人事代理机构与内部谈判
title_primary: 人事代理机构与内部谈判
title_secondary: Staffing agencies and in-house bargaining
authors: Agneta Berge, Ann-Sofie Kolm, Per Krusell
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Nowadays, many producing firms do not hire workers, but rent them from “staffing agencies”, whose main activity is to find, employ, and rent out workers to producing firms. That way, producing firms do not bear the direct costs of search and instead rent workers in a competitive market. We employ standard search-and-matching theory to analyze this phenomenon, with producing firms that have decreasing returns to scale. We find that the mere presence of staffing agencies has an important impact on the bargaining between the firms and their hired, “in-house” workers: firms can strategically use rented workers to weaken the bargaining position of in-house workers, tilting bargaining in their own favor. This has first-order effects on wages and employment. If rented and in-house workers are identical in production and in search markets, the unique equilibrium is one where producing firms only use rented workers. If renting workers involve additional costs, the equilibrium features an interior solution where each firm procures workers from two sources.

abstract: This paper examines the impact of Afghanistan's accession to the World Trade Organization (WTO) on its Agricultural Export Performance (), with a particular focus on the effects of Trade Liberalisation (). Using the Difference‐ in‐ Differences (DIDs) methodology, we found that has a positive and statistically significant effect on , suggesting that a 1% decrease in tariffs increases export value by approximately 0.124% in Afghanistan. This result is further validated by employing Double‐Selection LASSO Regression (DSLR), Bayesian Model Averaging (BMA) and Kernel‐Based Regularised Least Squares (KRLS) machine learning techniques. Additionally, endogeneity concerns are addressed using Trade Policy Uncertainty () as an Instrumental Variable (IV), with results indicating that the estimated effects are free from endogeneity bias. Moreover, heterogeneity analysis reveals that the impact of on varies across different income levels, regions and neighbouring country classifications. Furthermore, a three‐step mediation analysis demonstrates that Trade Costs () and Resource Allocation () partially mediate the relationship between and . Based on these empirical outcomes, several policy recommendations are discussed.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了阿富汗加入世界贸易组织（WTO）对其农业出口绩效的影响，特别关注贸易自由化的作用。采用双重差分法（DIDs），我们发现贸易自由化对农业出口绩效具有正向且统计显著的影响，表明关税每降低1%，阿富汗的出口价值约增加0.124%。这一结果通过双选择LASSO回归（DSLR）、贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）及基于核的正则化最小二乘法（KRLS）等机器学习技术进一步得到验证。此外，为处理内生性问题，我们使用贸易政策不确定性作为工具变量（IV），结果表明估计效应不存在内生性偏差。进一步地，异质性分析揭示，贸易自由化对农业出口绩效的影响在不同收入水平、地区及邻国分类间存在差异。再者，三步中介分析表明，贸易成本和资源配置在贸易自由化与农业出口绩效之间起到部分中介作用。基于上述实证结果，本文讨论了几项政策建议。

title: The Great Debasement and English overseas trade: Gresham and Johnson in context
title_zh: 大贬值和英国海外贸易：格雷欣与约翰逊的历史背景
title_primary: 大贬值和英国海外贸易：格雷欣与约翰逊的历史背景

authors: Ling‐Fan Li
official: 官方在线 2026-01-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract On the basis of price data collected from Gresham's Daybook and Johnson's letters, this article re‐examines a conventional argument in the literature: that currency depreciation during the Great Debasement made English cloth cheaper and thus stimulated an export boom. The price data reveal that the purchase prices of English wool and cloth rose at roughly same rate as the depreciation of pound sterling. The two effects of coinage debasement – inflation and currency depreciation – largely offset each other. Depreciation alone is insufficient to explain the sustained expansion of English exports, rather, strong foreign demand was likely to provide the underlying momentum for the English cloth boom.
abstract_zh: 摘要 基于从格雷沙姆日记和约翰逊信件中收集的价格数据，本文重新审视了文献中的一个传统论点：即大贬值期间货币贬值使英国布料更便宜，从而刺激了出口繁荣。价格数据显示，英国羊毛和布料的购买价格上升幅度与英镑贬值幅度大致相同。铸币贬值的两个效应——通货膨胀与货币贬值——在很大程度上相互抵消。仅凭贬值不足以解释英国出口的持续扩张，相反，强劲的外国需求可能为英国布料繁荣提供了根本动力。

title: Integrating a Free Online Service: Advertisements and Competitive Implications
title_zh: 整合免费在线服务：广告与竞争影响
title_primary: 整合免费在线服务：广告与竞争影响
title_secondary: Integrating a Free Online Service: Advertisements and Competitive Implications
authors: Gaurav Jakhu
official: 官方在线 2025-11-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines firms' incentives to integrate free, advertising‐financed online services with hardware products and their implications. Our analysis shows that service integration has a non‐monotonic effect on hardware prices while reducing advertising levels. Moreover, when the quality advantage is sufficiently large, integration increases both firms' profit by enabling them to monetize different user segments. However, for small to intermediate quality advantage, service integration can make the dominant firm better off and the rival firm worse off when the nuisance cost of advertisement is small to intermediate, and both firms better off when the nuisance cost of advertisement is sufficiently large. Finally, service integration can benefit users but harm advertisers.

title: Oil, sanctions, and survival: fresh insights into Iran’s financial (in)-stability
title_zh: 石油、制裁与生存：伊朗金融（不）稳定的新见解
title_primary: 石油、制裁与生存：伊朗金融（不）稳定的新见解
title_secondary: Oil, sanctions, and survival: fresh insights into Iran’s financial (in)-stability
authors: Irina Kalina Kazi Sohag Graduate School of Economics and Management, Ural Federal University, Yekaterinburg, Russia
official: 官方在线 2025-07-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We construct a comprehensive financial stress index (FSI) by leveraging all available time-series data for the Iranian economy, which has long contended with extensive financial and non-financial sanctions. To this end, we measure the dynamic response of this devised FSI to different exogenous shocks including expected and unexpected changes in oil price and production, well as Middle-East geopolitical crisis over Nov. 1997 to Dec. 2023 considering quantile and time frequency connected approaches. We find that the Iranian financial market is relatively more sensitive to changes in oil price than oil production shocks. Besides, the Iranian financial market is exposed with the hike of geopolitical events concerning Turkey and Israel, while it is less responsive to those events concerning Egypt and Saudi Arabia. Besides, Iranian financial market demonstrates resilience to oil price shocks before 2008. We also find that outbreak of COVID-19 or the escalation of the conflict between Russia and Ukraine did not cause financial stress in the Iranian financial market.
abstract_zh: 我们利用伊朗经济所有可用的时间序列数据，构建了一个全面的金融压力指数（FSI），该经济体长期面临广泛的金融和非金融制裁。为此，我们测量了这一设计的FSI对不同外生冲击的动态响应，包括油价和产量的预期及非预期变化，以及1997年11月至2023年12月期间中东地缘政治危机，采用分位数和时间频率关联方法。我们发现，伊朗金融市场对油价变化的敏感度相对高于石油产量冲击。此外，伊朗金融市场对涉及土耳其和以色列的地缘政治事件升级表现出暴露性，而对涉及埃及和沙特阿拉伯的事件反应较弱。同时，伊朗金融市场在2008年前对油价冲击表现出韧性。我们还发现，COVID-19的爆发或俄罗斯与乌克兰冲突的升级并未导致伊朗金融市场出现金融压力。
